title: Demethylzeylasteral alleviates inflammation and colitis via dual suppression of NF-kappaB and STAT3/5 by targeting IKKalpha/beta and JAK2.
authors: Wen, Tian; Liu, Ting; Chen, Hongqing; Liu, Qi; Shen, Xiaofei; Hu, Qiongying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Demethylzeylasteral通过靶向IKK和JAK2抑制NF-kB和STAT3/5信号通路缓解结肠炎，属于小分子-激酶互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a common inflammatory bowel disease and a risk factor of colorectal cancer. Demethylzeylasteral (DZT), a bioactive component mainly isolated from Tripterygium wilfordii, has been shown to inhibit inflammation and cancer. However, its anti-UC function and molecular mechanisms have not been well characterized. This study aims to explore the therapeutic effect and functional targets of demethylzeylasteral against UC. METHODS: RT-qPCR, Western blot and ELISA were used to detect the generation of pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines in murine macrophage cells. Luciferase reporter gene, Western blot, pull-down, CETSA, DARTS, and virtual docking were employed to detect the anti-inflammatory targets and molecular mechanisms of demethylzeylasteral. The anti-inflammatory and anti-colitis effects of demethylzeylasteral were further determined in DSS-challenged mice. RESULTS: In vitro, demethylzeylasteral inhibited NO and PGE(2) production by suppressing the mRNA and protein expression of iNOS and COX-2, and suppressed the mRNA expression of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, MCP-1, CXCL9, and CXCL10 in RAW264.7 macrophages stimulated by LPS/IFNgamma. Furthermore, demethylzeylasteral was not only capable of inhibiting IKKalpha/beta-NF-kappaB activation, but also able to block JAKs-STAT3/5 activation in LPS/INFgamma-incubated RAW264.7 cells or DSS-exposed colon tissues of mice. Mechanistically, demethylzeylasteral was found to directly bind to IKKalpha/beta and JAK2 kinases, leading to inactivation of pro-inflammatory signaling cascades and reduced generation of cytokines and chemokines. In vivo, oral administration of demethylzeylasteral significantly attenuated DSS-induced colitis, which was mainly manifested as mitigated symptoms of colitis, colonic mucosal barrier damage, and colonic inflammation. CONCLUSION: We demonstrated that demethylzeylasteral alleviated UC pathology by blocking NF-kappaB and STAT3/5 pathways via targeting IKKalpha/beta and JAK2 kinases, raising the possibility that demethylzeylasteral could act as a candidate for the treatment of UC.
abstract_zh: 背景：溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）是一种常见的炎症性肠病，也是结直肠癌的危险因素。去甲基泽拉醛（Demethylzeylasteral, DZT）是一种主要从雷公藤（Tripterygium wilfordii）中分离出的生物活性成分，已被证明具有抑制炎症和癌症的作用。然而，其抗UC功能及分子机制尚未得到充分表征。本研究旨在探讨去甲基泽拉醛对UC的治疗效果及功能靶点。方法：采用RT-qPCR、Western blot和ELISA检测小鼠巨噬细胞中促炎细胞因子和趋化因子的产生。使用荧光素酶报告基因、Western blot、pull-down、CETSA、DARTS和虚拟对接技术检测去甲基泽拉醛的抗炎靶点及分子机制。进一步在DSS诱导的小鼠中评估去甲基泽拉醛的抗炎和抗结肠炎效果。结果：在体外实验中，去甲基泽拉醛通过抑制iNOS和COX-2的mRNA及蛋白表达，抑制NO和PGE(2)的产生，并抑制LPS/IFNγ刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞中TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6、MCP-1、CXCL9和CXCL10的mRNA表达。此外，去甲基泽拉醛不仅能抑制IKKα/β-NF-κB激活，还能阻断LPS/IFNγ孵育的RAW264.7细胞或DSS暴露的小鼠结肠组织中的JAKs-STAT3/5激活。机制上，发现去甲基泽拉醛直接结合IKKα/β和JAK2激酶，导致促炎信号级联失活，并减少细胞因子和趋化因子的产生。在体内实验中，口服去甲基泽拉醛显著减轻了DSS诱导的结肠炎，主要表现为结肠炎症状、结肠黏膜屏障损伤和结肠炎症的缓解。结论：我们证明去甲基泽拉醛通过靶向IKKα/β和JAK2激酶阻断NF-κB和STAT3/5通路，从而缓解UC病理，提示去甲基泽拉醛可能作为治疗UC的候选药物。
